lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Solomon Islands using the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset represents approximately 99% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 3 years and recent updates within the last 6 months.
